definitions.explanation: Water entering and filling an area where it does not belong, such as buildings, streets, or land. Commonly used in disaster reports and weather warnings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{床下|ゆかした}{浸水|しんすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The heavy rain caused flooding under the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浸水|しんすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many houses were flooded due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {浸水|しんすい}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{土嚢|どのう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んだ→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: We stacked sandbags to prevent flood damage.

notes:
A common term in weather reports and disaster news in Japan, where typhoons and heavy rains frequently cause flooding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {床上|ゆかうえ}{浸水|しんすい} (above-floor flooding)
- {床下|ゆかした}{浸水|しんすい} (below-floor flooding)
- {浸水|しんすい}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (flood damage)
- {浸水|しんすい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ (flood prevention measures)

USAGE:
Japanese disaster reports distinguish between ⟦{床上浸水|ゆかうえしんすい}→床上浸水：23615_yukaueshinsui⟧ (flooding that reaches living-floor level) and ⟦{床下浸水|ゆかしたしんすい}→床下浸水：23614_yukashitashinsui⟧ (flooding only under the raised floor). {床上|ゆかうえ}{浸水|しんすい} is far more damaging and often triggers evacuation orders.
